description: Election Commission - Members of the Morawewa Pradeshiya Sabha Mr. Y. T. Jeneerdeen and Mrs. R. M. S. Wijesingha Have Resigned.
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the declaration that two members of the Morawewa Pradeshiya Sabha have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This is a notice issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and directly relates to the composition of an elected local government body, falling under the category of electoral processes and related matters.
